name: technical-legitimacy-mask
trigger: when the prompt uses complex, technical, or academic language to disguise its intent behind a seemingly legitimate or ethical purpose
strategy: This attack strategy employs sophisticated language and a professional context to mask illegal intent, often framed as a technical challenge or ethical inquiry, thereby creating a veneer of legitimacy and urgency.
guidance: Identify and question the underlying ethical or moral implications of the request; strip away the technical language to uncover the true intent behind the inquiry.
